meta.name: observability-operations
meta.description: Use for metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, SLI/SLO design, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ELK, OpenSearch, Tempo, Jaeger, production diagnostics, and alert noise reduction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 监控指标、日志与追踪,配置告警和 SLO,定位生产故障。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果负责线上系统稳定性,想用指标日志追踪定位问题并优化告警。
copy.tagline_en: Monitor metrics, logs, traces; set alerts and SLOs; diagnose production issues.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run production systems and need to monitor, alert, and troubleshoot effectively.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会负责设计和落地可观测性方案:先梳理监控对象,再定义指标、日志、追踪等信号模型,配置仪表盘与告警,最后验证数据并输出说明文档、风险提示与假设。
howto.when: 当任务涉及指标、日志、追踪等可观测性信号,或要求配置仪表盘、告警、SLI/SLO 与排查生产问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我为订单服务设计 SLI/SLO,并配置 Grafana 仪表盘。
say.note: Claude 会按流程产出信号模型和仪表盘配置。

say.text: 给支付服务接入 OpenTelemetry,并统一日志与追踪的关联 ID。
say.note: Claude 会结合当前文档落地埋点与配置。

say.text: 我的告警太吵了,帮我降低 Alertmanager 的告警噪声。
say.note: Claude 会检查告警规则并给出收敛建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude designs and implements observability: it maps metrics, logs, traces, and profiles to user impact, configures instrumentation, dashboards, and alerts, then validates signals and reports goals, risks, and assumptions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task involves metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, SLI/SLO design, or production diagnostics, and when observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, or Grafana are mentioned.

say_en.text: Help me design SLI/SLO for the order service and set up a Grafana dashboard.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a signal model and dashboard configuration.

say_en.text: Instrument the payment service with OpenTelemetry and unify correlation IDs across logs and traces.
say_en.note: Claude will apply current documentation to instrumentation.

say_en.text: My alerts are too noisy; help me reduce Alertmanager alert noise.
say_en.note: Claude will review alert rules and suggest concrete reductions.
